args: case $(uname -s) in Darwin) d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Erlkonig" ;; Linux) d=$XDG_DATA_HOME; [ -n "$d" ] || d="$HOME/.local/share"; d="$d/erlkonig" ;; *) d= ;; esac; b="$d/bin/erlkonig-node"; if [ -z "$d" ] || [ ! -x "$b" ]; then echo "Erlkonig is not installed on this $(uname -s) computer. Install the Erlkonig app and open it once." >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$b" mcp --data-dir "$d"
